# Section Template (Retired)

Use the consolidated [SRS section template](../development/SRS/03_SRS_Section_Template.md) for
new or updated Nexus requirements. It already includes placeholders for:

- Purpose, context, and legacy comparison (§[X.1]–§[X.3])
- Definitions and normative requirements (§[X.4]–§[X.5])
- Acceptance criteria, constraints, and traceability (§[X.6]–§[X.16])

Migrating open work into that document keeps requirements, options, and decisions in a
single location that can be versioned with the rest of the SRS.
